properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 13 at 7:19PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 719 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking an area of thunderstorms
across southern Park County and northern Fremont County, moving
northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Elevenmile Canyon Reservoir and Guffey.
